lines: The world's top leaders from humble backgrounds committed to supporting each other and making a positive global impact

The Fortis Society has assembled a diverse community of rising leaders from around the world who have pledged to help one another to reach the highest possible level of influence to amplify their positive impact on the world.

We, the proud Members of the Fortis Society, share challenging upbringings and have demonstrated extraordinary resilience. We are the first generation in our families to attend university and have graduated from some of the best-known institutions in the world on full scholarships and grants. Our backgrounds represent over 50 countries, and we are located across five continents. We are emerging leaders excelling in a variety of fields. We have found in Fortis a supportive and tight-knit global community where we all have the unbreakable determination to create meaningful positive social impact.
